design: Treat JOB_GPUS, STEP_GPUS and detailed GRES IDX as scheduler identifiers; validate them within the scheduler record.
Observe configured task/cgroup device enforcement and exact current job/step/task cgroup membership.
Independently identify the sole visible whole physical GPU by UUID, PCI address, model, memory and driver, and bind the same UUID in the actual numerical child.
Record v1 readable device rules when available; v2 configured isolation relies on the scheduler because live BPF rules were not independently inspected.
Keep the observed driver580.159.04 qualification distinct from the original direct-reference driver590.48.01, while preserving full numerical/source/precision/software gates.

sources.supports: Allocated GRES device descriptors are enforced by character-device major/minor rules.
Slurm GPU environment identifiers and local visibility are distinct namespaces.
The merged GRES list ordering uses File and Links self-position; physical PCI/minor rank alone is insufficient.
Version2 device restrictions use BPF rather than devices.list.
Current NVML handle index is not a historical Slurmd enumeration proof.
